subject.title: feat(gateway): include produced messageId on chat final/aborted events

question: Should `messageId` become the supported stable transcript identity on public gateway final and aborted chat events?
rationale: External clients would rely on this as a durable message-delivery deduplication contract, so long-term API support requires explicit gateway-owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor the additive field
options.body: Accept the field after full-path tests and live gateway-client proof confirm exact persisted-message correlation.

options.title: Keep correlation client-side
options.body: Decline the new public field and retain transcript lookup or another client-owned correlation strategy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the additive field
recommendation.body: Accept the field after full-path tests and live gateway-client proof confirm exact persisted-message correlation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent ownership of the public terminal event schemas and gateway chat projection.
